sentences.text:
Special (Pocso) Court vs In Re : Imam Sk on 2 September, 2025
02.09.2025
Item no. 2
Court No.42
 ab High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Miscellaneous Jurisdiction
 C.R.M.(M) 1193 of 2025
 In Re:- An application under Section 439 of the Criminal
 Procedure Code, 1973 corresponding to Section 483 of the
 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with
 C.Spl. Case No.50 of 2020 corresponding to Berhampore Police
 Station Case No.620 of 2020 dated 29.06.2020 under Sections
 376/370/372/373/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections
 3/4/5/7 of I.T.P.A., 1965 and Sections 4/8/12/17 of the
 Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and Section 75
 of the J.J. Act pending before the Court of learned Judge,
 Special (Pocso) Court, Murshidabad at Berhampore.
 And

In Re : Imam Sk.
 .... Petitioner
 Mr. Arnab Chatterjee
 Mr. Anisur Rahaman
 ... for the petitioner
 Md. Adil Badr,
 Mr. Sobhan Gani
 ... for the State

Ms. Jonaki Saha
 .... for the de facto complainant/
 victim under serial no.15 of memo
 of evidence
 1.
States files a report dated 31st August, 2025, which is taken on record.
2.  Learned Advocate for the State submits that service upon the victims under serial Nos. 13 and 14 of the Memo of Evidence could not be effected since they could not be traced out.
With regard to the victims, who are the residents of Bangladesh, steps have already been taken but some more time is required to effect service.

3. State is directed to effect service upon the victims under serial nos. 13 and 14 of the Memo of Evidence as well as the victims, who are the residents of Bangladesh and file service report on the returnable date.
